title: Angler's Edge Fishing Charters
specs: Fishing for Chinook, Coho, Atlantic salmon, steelhead/rainbow trout, brown trout
Anglers between 16-65 need a fishing license in Ontario
Fishing licenses must be carried and shown during the trip
Up to 3 people: $650 per 5 hour trip
4-5 people (only with one or two children): $800 per 5 hour trip
Groups 6 and over: two boats arranged to fish in teams
includes: Rods, tackle, bait and all other gear needed
gap: Exact age minimum and maximum for guests not stated
blurb: Guests fish aboard a licensed and insured Grady White boat in Toronto, Ontario. Trips focus on strategic, conservation-minded sportfishing for species like salmon and trout. Rods, tackle, bait, and gear are supplied.
extraNote: Rain policy: pack lightly · For groups larger than 5, two boats and captains are arranged · South parking lot entrance at Bluffer’s Park Marina, Scarborough area, Toronto, Ontario
